array.string: F="$HOME/Library/Application Support/MeetRec/running"; [ -f "$F" ] && ! /usr/bin/pgrep -qx MeetRec && { echo "$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S.000') WARN [watchdog] MeetRec is not running, relaunching" >> "$HOME/Library/Logs/MeetRec/meetrec.log"; app=$(/usr/bin/sed -n 2p "$F"); if [ -d "$app" ]; then /usr/bin/open -g "$app" --args --background; else /usr/bin/open -g -b com.dmemruk.MeetRec --args --background; fi; }; exit 0
